description: Export with any of the Export section's options, the files written on this computer as the tab renders them (no size limit): an image (png, jpg) at `seconds`, or a video (mp4, webm, gif, png-sequence) over `inSeconds`–`outSeconds`; `scale` 0.5–4, `fps`, `background: false` for transparency (PNG, WebM, PNG sequence); `artboard` an artboard's id or label, or "all" for one file each; `deliver` a destination's preset (app-store with `device` iphone/ipad/mac, keynote, powerpoint, google-slides). Only what you pass changes, and only for this export: the person's settings stay. `path` is a folder, or a file name for a single file (default ./paraplex-exports). A Free account gets the reason a Pro export is refused.
name: export
